notes: The system controls are now a Sensu-style pie. Pull left from the Orb and the controls spread along an arc around your thumb: sweep to a slice and let go — the flashlight and ringer fire on release, so opening the pie never sets anything off. Brightness and Volume bend round the pie: push out past the ring and sweep to set them. Make it yours in Settings > Home & Orb > System controls fan: reorder the slices, hide ones you don't use, pick the fan size.
